title: hatchwatch.camera_masks v1
description: Operator-drawn camera watch areas in 1280x720 source-frame pixels, written by the HatchWatch dashboard to MASKS_ROOT/camera-masks.json (artifacts/operator). pipeline/extract.py (frozen) reads only cameras[]: it picks the entry whose integer camera equals the runner's camera slot (0 or 1). The dashboard derives cameras[] from its per-camera masks (slot 0 = newest odd-numbered camera mask, slot 1 = newest even-numbered one, else the repository default from config/camera-masks.json). by_code holds each dashboard camera's own mask and is ignored by the runner. Operator configuration, never simulator truth; registered experiments must be re-validated after any mask change.
